authority: T0 exact analytic classical composition candidate certificate; not a TECT claim, tier change, finite-a Goursat scheme, quantum-state composition, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: For C8 characteristic traces inside common strict CL8 Goursat gates, the final null-triangle slice supplies a Cauchy phase pair. On the restricted periodic-jet-compatible branch this pair initializes the inherited periodic semidiscrete regulator directly and preserves the Goursat energy and variational symplectic ledgers up to fixed-H7-by-H6-family O(a^2) sampling error. For generic admitted traces, explicit finite-degree Hermite jet fills on a larger circle give a deterministic classical initialization, with every exterior energy and symplectic contribution retained as a separate extension ledger. Exact sampling gives zero initial modified error, the inherited semidiscrete theorem gives O(a^2) grid-phase convergence, trigonometric reconstruction gives O(a^2) convergence in a common H1 times L2 phase space, and supplied compactly supported classical phase measures converge in W1 at O(a^2). The original mixed composition gate is resolved only by splitting off a still-open preferred-state/measure-selection gate covering both classical selection and quantum composition.
verdict: CLOSE THE DECLARED CLASSICAL FIXED-SLICE KINEMATIC COMPOSITION SUBGATE BY DIRECT-SEAM AND EXPLICIT-EXTENSION BRANCHES; RETAIN THE FULL-CIRCUMFERENCE GOURSAT AND PREFERRED-STATE/MEASURE-SELECTION GATES

unrestricted_same_domain_no_go.fixture: r=g=lambda=chi=c=R=1, tau=1/10, A(u)=0, B(v)=v e_1, C=0
unrestricted_same_domain_no_go.wrap_energy: the current same-domain periodic wrap bond is asymptotic to c/(400a)
unrestricted_same_domain_no_go.verdict: REFUTED for generic admitted data without a seam restriction, extra extension data, or a changed boundary discretization
unrestricted_same_domain_no_go.survivors: the matched direct seam, the separately declared larger-domain Hermite alternative with H_ext and Omega_ext, and other independently verified boundary schemes remain open or proved at their stated scopes

phase_slice.input: A,B in C8([0,2tau];R8), A(0)=B(0), supported inside common strict max-ball Goursat gates
phase_slice.regularity: the Goursat bootstrap gives psi in C8, hence q in C8(I_tau) and Pi in C7(I_tau); the phase map is continuous in the C8 trace topology on common strict gates
phase_slice.force_integrals: I_A=(4chi)^(-1) integral_0^(2tau) grad W(A(sigma)) dsigma and I_B=(4chi)^(-1) integral_0^(2tau) grad W(B(nu)) dnu
phase_slice.measure_topology_boundary: the earlier supplied field-value measure in the sup topology is insufficient because Pi depends on A' and B'; this package requires a newly supplied phase-capable measure in the C8 trace topology

direct_periodic_branch.domain: L=2s tau and I_tau is identified with T_L
direct_periodic_branch.seam: partial_x^m q(-s tau)=partial_x^m q(s tau) for 0<=m<=7 and partial_x^m Pi(-s tau)=partial_x^m Pi(s tau) for 0<=m<=6
direct_periodic_branch.seam_status: a strong correlated-data restriction, not a consequence of A(0)=B(0) and not a selected physical boundary condition
direct_periodic_branch.grid: for even M, a=L/M, x_j=-s tau+ja, u_j=2tau*j/M, v_j=2tau-u_j, and the inherited fine size N=2M is divisible by four
direct_periodic_branch.initialization: q_j^a(0)=q(x_j) and Pi_j^a(0)=Pi(x_j), so e(0)=e_t(0)=0 and E_alpha(0)=0 exactly
direct_periodic_branch.energy_ledger: the periodic continuum Hamiltonian equals the Goursat slice energy and hence the exact two-sheet null flux before sampling
direct_periodic_branch.symplectic_ledger: the periodic continuum variational form equals the Goursat slice form and hence the exact two-sheet variational flux before sampling

hermite_extension_branch.domain: choose any L>2s tau and d=L-2s tau; retain I_tau and fill only its complementary arc
hermite_extension_branch.position_fill: the unique polynomial of degree at most 15 whose y=(x-s tau)/d derivatives 0 through 7 equal d^k times the right and left q jets produces E7 q in C7_per(T_L)
hermite_extension_branch.momentum_fill: the unique polynomial of degree at most 13 whose y derivatives 0 through 6 equal d^k times the right and left Pi jets produces E6 Pi in C6_per(T_L)
hermite_extension_branch.existence: the two confluent Hermite matrices are nonsingular, so this deterministic extension exists for every admitted C8 Goursat pair
hermite_extension_branch.continuity: for fixed d>0 both finite-dimensional jet fills define bounded linear extension maps in the declared trace norms
hermite_extension_branch.energy_ledger: H_per(E7 q,E6 Pi)=E_tau+H_ext exactly, where H_ext is the signed Hamiltonian integral over the complementary arc and is generally nonzero and extension-dependent
hermite_extension_branch.symplectic_ledger: Omega_per=Omega_H+Omega_ext exactly for extended tangent pairs; Omega_ext is generally nonzero and extension-dependent
hermite_extension_branch.interpretation: this is a mathematical initialization convention, not a proof that generic boundary data canonically select the same global periodic state

periodic_cauchy_theorem.data: either branch gives q0 in H7(T_L;R8) and Pi0/chi in H6(T_L;R8)
periodic_cauchy_theorem.wellposedness: the local H7 times H6 semilinear periodic wave solution extends to every fixed finite T: the coercive quartic Hamiltonian controls H1 and L-infinity in one dimension, and differentiated energy estimates propagate all higher Sobolev norms
periodic_cauchy_theorem.parent_regularities: the resulting solution lies in C0_t C6_x intersect C2_t C0_x and has finite fixed-T M4 and M6 bounds, so it satisfies the semidiscrete parent's analytic hypotheses
periodic_cauchy_theorem.uniform_family: on a compact C8 boundary-data set inside common strict gates, extension, flow, max-ball, M4, M6, and semidiscrete constants are uniform
periodic_cauchy_theorem.semidiscrete_conclusion: exact sampled initialization sets C_init=0 and yields sup_[0,T](||psi^a-R_a Psi||_H1a+||psi^a_t-R_a Psi_t||_a)<=C_T a^2

energy_consistency.statement: for every fixed periodic H7 x H6 phase pair, |H_a(R_a q,R_a Pi)-H_per(q,Pi)|<=C_E a^2
energy_consistency.reason: periodic composite-trapezoid error controls kinetic plus potential terms, while the forward-gradient ledger differs from the continuum gradient energy by the cellwise derivative variance
energy_consistency.time_propagation: if the finite flow is initialized by sampled q0,Pi0, then H_a(psi^a(t),Pi^a(t))-H(Psi(t),Pi(t))=H_a(R_a q0,R_a Pi0)-H(q0,Pi0); no conservation is claimed for freshly resampling the continuum phase at each time
energy_consistency.not_exact: point sampling has high-frequency kernels and is not an exact finite-a energy map on arbitrary frequency families

symplectic_consistency.statement: for two fixed high-regularity tangent phases, |Omega_a(R_a v1,R_a v2)-Omega_per(v1,v2)|<=(L a^2/96)||partial_x^2(Pi1 dot q2-Pi2 dot q1)||_infinity
symplectic_consistency.direct_variations: on the direct branch each tangent phase must be DS_tau[A,B](delta A,delta B) with the boundary variation tangent to all periodic jet-seam constraints; arbitrary Goursat variations need not be periodic
symplectic_consistency.direct_flux: on the direct seam branch Omega_per=Omega_H exactly before sampling
symplectic_consistency.extension_flux: on the extension branch Omega_per=Omega_H+Omega_ext exactly before sampling
symplectic_consistency.time_propagation: finite tangent flows initialized by sampled continuum tangent data and the corresponding continuum tangent flows preserve their separate forms, so their form difference equals the initial O(a^2) sampling discrepancy; freshly sampled continuum tangents are not called a conserved finite flow
symplectic_consistency.not_exact: the family f_M=sin(2pi M x/L) vanishes at every M-grid node while a continuum tangent pair built from f_M has symplectic value -L/16

trigonometric_reconstruction.operator: J_a is the periodic trigonometric interpolant of the M grid values, with the real even-M Nyquist convention
trigonometric_reconstruction.stability: for the real even-M cosine Nyquist convention, ||J_a z||_L2,8^2=||z||_a^2-(1/2)||z_N||_a^2, hence (1/2)||z||_a^2<=||J_a z||_L2,8^2<=||z||_a^2; also ||partial_x J_a z||_L2,8<=(pi/2)||D_a^+z||_a
trigonometric_reconstruction.multiplier_proof: for |ka|<=pi, |k|/[2|sin(ka/2)|/a]<=pi/2 by concavity of sin on [0,pi/2]
trigonometric_reconstruction.smooth_interpolation: standard periodic Fourier interpolation gives ||J_a R_a f-f||_H1=O(a^2) for f in H3 and ||J_a R_a h-h||_L2=O(a^2) for h in H2
trigonometric_reconstruction.common_space_rate: combining interpolation with the parent's discrete estimate gives ||J_a psi^a-Psi||_H1,8+||J_a psi_t^a-Psi_t||_L2,8<=C_T a^2
trigonometric_reconstruction.piecewise_linear_boundary: this does not contradict the parent warning: ordinary piecewise-linear reconstruction generally gives only O(a) in continuous H1

classical_phase_measure.input: a supplied Borel probability measure mu on a compact C8 boundary-data set inside common strict gates, with direct-seam support when the direct branch is used
classical_phase_measure.maps: F_t sends traces through the phase slice, chosen domain branch, and continuum Cauchy flow; F_a,t additionally samples, evolves semidiscretely, and applies J_a
classical_phase_measure.rate: uniform deterministic convergence and the identity coupling give W1_X((F_a,t)_*mu,(F_t)_*mu)<=C_K,T a^2 in X=H1_8 times L2_8
classical_phase_measure.scope: mu and the direct-seam correlation or extension rule are inputs; no invariant, thermal, vacuum, Hadamard, or quantum state is selected

hostile_boundaries.generic_direct_seam: if delta=B(2tau)-A(2tau) is nonzero, the wrap bond contributes c|delta|^2/(16a)+O(1); the exact admitted A=0, B(v)=v e_1, tau=1/10 fixture has self-map 47/200, contraction 1/10, delta=e_1/5 and wrap asymptotic c/(400a); if values match but the first derivative jumps, the seam Laplacian has an O(1/a) residual
hostile_boundaries.field_measure_loss: A_n=n^(-1)sin(nu) tends uniformly to zero but A_n' does not, so the old field-value sup topology cannot support a continuous momentum map
hostile_boundaries.sampling_kernel: M-dependent continuum modes can vanish at all M nodes while retaining nonzero continuum energy and symplectic form; every consistency statement is for fixed bounded high-regularity families
hostile_boundaries.finite_a_tail: registered finite-a variational witness tails remain nonzero; this package gives convergence and aggregate controls, not exact support
hostile_boundaries.pah1_full_circle: with inserted L=pi/2, c/chi=1, -2r/chi=9 and R at least sqrt(-r/g), the current one-patch contraction factor obeys q>=9pi^2/32>1; even a shifted ordered-neighbourhood factor obeys q>=9pi^2/64>1
hostile_boundaries.pah1_interpretation: the inequality blocks the current Banach certificate, not existence; the exact constant ordered equilibrium remains a special solution

prior_art_boundary: Characteristic-to-Cauchy slicing, Hermite jet extension, periodic semilinear-wave wellposedness, finite-difference convergence, trapezoidal quadrature, trigonometric interpolation, symplectic consistency, and deterministic-coupling Wasserstein bounds are established mathematics. No world-first or new general theorem is claimed. The repository-specific result is the exact CL8/Q3 convention bridge, physical one-eighth ledger, two-branch seam/extension audit, gate-scope split, and PA-H1 calibration obstruction.
no_overclaim: This package proves only a finite-regularity H7 x H6 classical fixed-background composition after either strong periodic seam correlations or a declared larger-domain extension carrying extra exterior ledgers. It refutes generic unchanged same-domain periodic composition but does not refute or canonically select an extension or another boundary scheme. It does not prove a finite-a Goursat scheme, exact finite-a energy or symplectic matching, arbitrary-frequency convergence, exact finite-a support, the current one-patch theorem at full ordered PA-H1 circumference, growing-time or thermodynamic regulator removal, full 3+1 dynamics, a quantum continuum or selected state, physical empty space or a below-empty-space sign, cooling, gravity, an event horizon, advancement of C6, CP1, or Pre-A.
